thread:
Jordan (AcmeApp): hey team — hitting 429s and intermittent 401s starting ~10:00 UTC after we flipped billing to paid. latency also spiked to ~1.2s per request. we're blocked in prod. any quick checks?

Emily (Support): sorry you're seeing this, jordan. can you paste the exact error payload or a sample curl? also which plan did you move to? free -> standard or free -> enterprise?

Jordan (AcmeApp): moved from free to standard (monthly). billing page shows payment succeeded. sample response: { \"error\": \"rate_limit_exceeded\", \"retry_after\": 60 } and sometimes `401: invalid_api_key` even though key works in dev.

Liam (SRE): 401 + 429 combo usually means key rotation + burst throttle. do you have multiple services using the same key? any policy changes on your side?

Jordan (AcmeApp): single key, used by a lambda that fans out. dev traffic is fine. prod traffic is higher but should be within standard plan cap (we calculated ~45 req/s).

Emily (Support): can you run this quick check and paste the headers? `curl -I -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate` we want to see `x-rw-rate-limit-*` headers and `x-request-id`

Jordan (AcmeApp): ran it, headers: `x-rw-rate-limit-limit: 10000`, `x-rw-rate-limit-remaining: 0`, `x-rw-rate-limit-reset: 165` and request id `req_01H4Y...`. also saw transient 401 once when deploying a new version that reloaded env vars.

Liam (SRE): that header combo explains it — remaining=0 means the token exhausted its quota window. the 401 during deploy likely from a short period where the service read an empty env var. two separate signals.

Emily (Support): ok, for immediate mitigation we can: 1) issue a temporary burst allowance for the next 30m; 2) request a sales-assisted quota bump for standard plan; 3) suggest short-term client-side backoff and jitter. do you want me to open a sales handoff?

Jordan (AcmeApp): yes please, temporary burst + sales ping. also want clear repro steps so my engineers can prevent this in future.

Cara (Sales): looped in — can offer a temporary increase while we evaluate committed capacity. will need expected sustained RPS and peak RPS numbers plus average tokens per request. jordan, can you DM those?

Jordan (AcmeApp): DMing now: sustained 30 rps, peak 120 rps for ~45s every 5m, avg 350 tokens/request.

Liam (SRE): for repro and long term: 1) reproduce locally with a small script that mirrors your fanout + request size; example below. 2) enable token-level caching or prefix caching for repeated prompts. 3) distribute traffic across multiple API keys or use our Dedicated offering for predictable capacity.

```bash
# repro script (basic):
for i in {1..400}; do
  curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -d '{"input":"<your prompt>"}' &
  sleep 0.1
done
wait
```

Emily (Support): adding a small recommended backoff snippet for client: exponential backoff with full jitter and honoring `retry_after`. sample pseudo: `sleep = min(60, base * 2**attempt) * rand()` and stop at 5 retries.

Cara (Sales): created ticket RW-SALES-1421 and offered a 2x spike buffer for 24h while we evaluate enterprise commitment. will include pricing options.

ops-bot: ticket created: RW-SUPPORT-6882, assigned to Emily. SLA: response within 2h.

Jordan (AcmeApp): temporary burst applied — thank you. after applying client jitter we saw no more 401s and 429s dropped to rare. will follow up on sales options.

Emily (Support): great — I'll keep RW-SUPPORT-6882 open until the sales path is confirmed and you verify 24h stability. let us know if you want help instrumenting `x-rw-rate-limit-*` scraping or a shared dashboard. :thumbsup:

Liam (SRE): logged a recommendation in your ticket: consider token batching and request pooling, and avoid single-key fanout >100 concurrent requests.

Jordan (AcmeApp): thanks all. attaching logs and the repro results to the ticket. appreciate the fast handoff. :pray:

Cara (Sales): following up tomorrow with a one-pager on Dedicated vs Reserved throughput.

Emily (Support): closing the loop here — mark as resolved if everything stays green after 24h and sales has the follow-up.

Jordan (AcmeApp): will confirm. thanks!
